mapper.delete: DELETE FROM oidc_flows WHERE expires_at < now()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oidc_flows (state, nonce, verifier, link_user_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{state}, #{nonce}, #{verifier}, #{linkUserId}, now() + make_interval(secs => #{ttlSeconds}))
mapper.select: DELETE FROM oidc_flows WHERE state = #{state} AND expires_at > now() RETURNING nonce, verifier, link_user_id
SELECT user_id FROM oidc_identities WHERE issuer = #{issuer} AND subject = #{subject}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oidc_identities (issuer, subject, user_id) VALUES (#{issuer}, #{subject}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT i.user_id FROM oidc_identities i JOIN users u ON u.id = i.user_id WHERE i.issuer = #{issuer} AND i.subject = #{subject} AND u.deactivated_at IS NULL
SELECT subject FROM oidc_identities WHERE issuer = #{issuer} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM oidc_identities WHERE issuer = #{issuer} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT jsonb_build_object('user_id', i.user_id, 'subject', i.subject, 'email', u.email)::text FROM oidc_identities i JOIN users u ON u.id = i.user_id WHERE i.issuer = #{issuer} AND u.org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY u.email
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM oidc_identities WHERE issuer = #{issuer} AND user_id = #{userId} AND user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE org_id = #{orgId})
DELETE FROM oidc_exchanges WHERE expires_at < now()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oidc_exchanges (token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, to_timestamp(#{expiresAtSeconds})) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
